shell_text.default: [topic]. If you freeze or repeat, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
Name [a/an] [broad_topics], one at a time. If you freeze or repeat, take [Penalty, 1] and you're out. Last one standing wins. [Player A], you start.
Name [a/an] [broad_topics] that starts with '[common_letters]'. If you repeat or can't think of one, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
Name any word that starts with '[uncommon_letters]'. If you repeat or make up a word, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
Word chain (fire truck → truck stop → stop sign). Start with '[chain_starters]'. If you freeze or break the chain, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
Word stack. Each player repeats the phrase, then adds one word to extend the sentence. If you mess up or break the sentence, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], start with '[stack_starters]...'.
Words that rhyme with '[rhyme_starters]'. If you repeat or hesitate, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
[Player A] vs [Player B], [topic]. Take turns naming one. First to repeat or freeze takes [Penalty, 2-3].
Words that start with '[prefixes]'. If you freeze or make up a word, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
Words that end with '[suffixes]'. If you freeze or make up a word, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A], you start.
[alphabet_topics], A to Z. Each player names one starting with the next letter. If you repeat or can't think of one, take [Penalty, 2-3]. [Player A] starts with A.

Cheers to the Governor! Count to 21, one number each. Whoever says 21 makes a rule, and everyone takes [Penalty, 1]. Mess up and take [Penalty, 1], then start over. The third 21 ends the game. [Player A] starts.

how_to_play.default: Count up from 1 around the group, one number each. Whoever says 21 makes a new rule, like clapping instead of saying 7, and everyone yells 'Cheers to the Governor!' and takes a penalty. Start again from 1 with every rule in play until the third 21. Mess up and you take a penalty and start over.
